Since you didn't reply within 3 days, our policy is that the out-of-stock fern is **automatically refunded**. Your email went out 4 days ago, so that window has passed and the refund should already have been triggered for that item.

- **Only the fern is refunded.** The rest of your order isn't affected by this.
- **I can't see your order or refund status.** The policy I have doesn't say how long an automatic refund takes to reach your payment method, so I can't give you a date. Please check your order in "My Orders" and your payment method for the refund.
- **If you still want a fern**, you'd need to place a new order. Choosing a similar plant or waiting up to 14 days was only possible by replying within the 3 days.

If you don't see the refund, I can escalate it to a Support Lead. Send me your order number (it looks like LF-123456) and I'll include it. Please don't send any card details or passwords.
